name: binhex-official-gluetun
description: Gluetun is a lightweight swiss-knife-like VPN client to tunnel to Cyberghost, ExpressVPN, FastestVPN, HideMyAss, IPVanish, IVPN, Mullvad, NordVPN, Perfect Privacy, Privado, PrivateVPN, ProtonVPN, PureVPN, Surfshark, TorGuard, VyprVPN, Windscribe servers using OpenVPN or Wireguard, iptables killswitch, DNS over TLS, ShadowSocks, and an HTTP proxy server.

paths.name: Path: /gluetun
paths.description: This is the container path to store gluetun related configuration.

variables.name: Variable: VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDER
variables.description: Specify a supported VPN provider to use

variables.name: Variable: VPN_TYPE
variables.description: VPN protocol to use. Not all providers support Wireguard.

variables.name: Variable: VPN_INTERFACE
variables.description: Specify a custom network interface name to use

variables.name: Variable: PRIVATE_INTERNET_ACCESS_OPENVPN_ENCRYPTION_PRESET
variables.description: Encryption preset, 'none' disables the cipher and auth OpenVPN options (not recommended).

variables.name: Variable: OPENVPN_USER
variables.description: OpenVPN username (required for OpenVPN)

variables.name: Variable: OPENVPN_PASSWORD
variables.description: OpenVPN password (required for OpenVPN)

variables.name: Variable: OPENVPN_PROTOCOL
variables.description: Network protocol to use for OpenVPN

variables.name: Variable: OPENVPN_VERSION
variables.description: Set the OpenVPN version to run

variables.name: Variable: OPENVPN_ENDPOINT_IP
variables.description: Specify a target VPN server IP address to use

variables.name: Variable: OPENVPN_ENDPOINT_PORT
variables.description: Specify a target VPN server port number to use

variables.name: Variable: OPENVPN_VERBOSITY
variables.description: OpenVPN verbosity level (1-6)

variables.name: Variable: OPENVPN_FLAGS
variables.description: Space delimited OpenVPN flags to pass to openvpn

variables.name: Variable: OPENVPN_ROOT
variables.description: Run OpenVPN as root

variables.name: Variable: OPENVPN_CIPHERS
variables.description: Specify a custom cipher to use (e.g. aes-256-gcm)

variables.name: Variable: OPENVPN_AUTH
variables.description: Specify a custom auth algorithm to use (e.g. sha256)

variables.name: Variable: OPENVPN_MSSFIX
variables.description: Set the MSS fix parameter (0-9999, 0 to use defaults)

variables.name: Variable: OPENVPN_CUSTOM_CONFIG
variables.description: Path to custom OpenVPN configuration file for custom provider

variables.name: Variable: WIREGUARD_PRIVATE_KEY
variables.description: Wireguard client private key (required for Wireguard)

variables.name: Variable: WIREGUARD_ADDRESSES
variables.description: Wireguard IP network interface address (xx.xx.xx.xx/xx)

variables.name: Variable: WIREGUARD_PUBLIC_KEY
variables.description: Wireguard server public key

variables.name: Variable: WIREGUARD_ENDPOINT_IP
variables.description: Wireguard server endpoint IP address

variables.name: Variable: WIREGUARD_ENDPOINT_PORT
variables.description: Wireguard server endpoint port number

variables.name: Variable: WIREGUARD_PRESHARED_KEY
variables.description: Wireguard pre-shared key

variables.name: Variable: WIREGUARD_ALLOWED_IPS
variables.description: Wireguard peer allowed IPs (CSV format)

variables.name: Variable: WIREGUARD_IMPLEMENTATION
variables.description: Wireguard implementation to use

variables.name: Variable: WIREGUARD_MTU
variables.description: Wireguard MTU (1-65535)

variables.name: Variable: WIREGUARD_PERSISTENT_KEEPALIVE_INTERVAL
variables.description: Wireguard persistent keepalive interval (e.g. 25s)

variables.name: Variable: SERVER_COUNTRIES
variables.description: Comma separated list of countries

variables.name: Variable: SERVER_REGIONS
variables.description: Comma separated list of regions

variables.name: Variable: SERVER_CITIES
variables.description: Comma separated list of cities

variables.name: Variable: SERVER_HOSTNAMES
variables.description: Comma separated list of server hostnames

variables.name: Variable: SERVER_NAMES
variables.description: Comma separated list of server names

variables.name: Variable: SERVER_CATEGORIES
variables.description: Comma separated list of server categories (NordVPN)

variables.name: Variable: VPN_PORT_FORWARDING
variables.description: Enable custom port forwarding code for supported providers

variables.name: Variable: VPN_PORT_FORWARDING_PROVIDER
variables.description: Choose the custom port forwarding code to use

variables.name: Variable: VPN_PORT_FORWARDING_STATUS_FILE
variables.description: File path to use for writing the forwarded port obtained

variables.name: Variable: VPN_PORT_FORWARDING_LISTENING_PORT
variables.description: Port redirection for the VPN server side port forwarded

variables.name: Variable: FIREWALL_VPN_INPUT_PORTS
variables.description: Comma separated list of ports to allow from the VPN server side

variables.name: Variable: FIREWALL_INPUT_PORTS
variables.description: Comma separated list of ports to allow through the default interface

variables.name: Variable: FIREWALL_DEBUG
variables.description: Prints every firewall related command (debugging only)

variables.name: Variable: FIREWALL_OUTBOUND_SUBNETS
variables.description: Comma separated subnets that Gluetun is allowed to access

variables.name: Variable: DNS_SERVER
variables.description: Activate DNS over TLS with Unbound

variables.name: Variable: DNS_UPSTREAM_RESOLVER_TYPE
variables.description: How to connect to upstream DNS servers: dot (DNS over TLS), doh (DNS over HTTPS), plain (UDP DNS)

variables.name: Variable: DNS_UPSTREAM_RESOLVERS
variables.description: Comma delimited list of DNS over TLS providers, valid values are: 'google', 'quad9', 'quadrant', 'cleanbrowsing', 'libredns', 'opendns'

variables.name: Variable: DNS_UNBLOCK_HOSTNAMES
variables.description: Comma separated list of domain names to leave unblocked from the filtering

variables.name: Variable: DNS_CACHING
variables.description: Unbound caching

variables.name: Variable: DNS_BLOCK_IP_PREFIXES
variables.description: All private CIDRs ranges. Comma separated list of CIDRs or single IP addresses Unbound won't resolve to. Note that the default setting prevents DNS rebinding

variables.name: Variable: DNS_UPSTREAM_IPV6
variables.description: DNS IPv6 resolution

variables.name: Variable: DNS_BLOCK_IPS
variables.description: Comma separated list of IP addresses to not resolve public domains to

variables.name: Variable: DNS_REBINDING_PROTECTION_EXEMPT_HOSTNAMES
variables.description: Comma separated list of public domain names to exclude from DNS rebinding protection

variables.name: Variable: DNS_UPDATE_PERIOD
variables.description: Period to update block lists and restart Unbound (e.g. 24h, 0 to disable)

variables.name: Variable: DNS_ADDRESS
variables.description: IP address to use as DNS resolver

variables.name: Variable: DNS_KEEP_NAMESERVER
variables.description: Keep /etc/resolv.conf untouched

variables.name: Variable: BLOCK_MALICIOUS
variables.description: Block malicious hostnames and IPs with Unbound

variables.name: Variable: BLOCK_SURVEILLANCE
variables.description: Block surveillance hostnames and IPs with Unbound

variables.name: Variable: BLOCK_ADS
variables.description: Block ads hostnames and IPs with Unbound

variables.name: Variable: HTTPPROXY
variables.description: Enable the internal HTTP proxy

variables.name: Variable: HTTPPROXY_LOG
variables.description: Logs every tunnel requests

variables.name: Variable: HTTPPROXY_LISTENING_ADDRESS
variables.description: Internal listening address for the HTTP proxy

variables.name: Variable: HTTPPROXY_USER
variables.description: Username to use to connect to the HTTP proxy

variables.name: Variable: HTTPPROXY_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password to use to connect to the HTTP proxy

variables.name: Variable: HTTPPROXY_STEALTH
variables.description: Stealth mode means HTTP proxy headers are not added

variables.name: Variable: SHADOWSOCKS
variables.description: Enable the internal Shadowsocks proxy

variables.name: Variable: SHADOWSOCKS_LOG
variables.description: Enable Shadowsocks logging

variables.name: Variable: SHADOWSOCKS_LISTENING_ADDRESS
variables.description: Internal listening address for Shadowsocks

variables.name: Variable: SHADOWSOCKS_PASSWORD
variables.description: Password to use to connect to Shadowsocks

variables.name: Variable: SHADOWSOCKS_CIPHER
variables.description: AEAD Cipher to use for Shadowsocks

variables.name: Variable: HTTP_CONTROL_SERVER_AUTH_DEFAULT_ROLE
variables.description: Authentication configuration for the HTTP Control Server

variables.name: Variable: HTTP_CONTROL_SERVER_ADDRESS
variables.description: Listening address for the HTTP Control Server

variables.name: Variable: HTTP_CONTROL_SERVER_LOG
variables.description: Enable logging of requests for the HTTP Control Server

variables.name: Variable: HTTP_CONTROL_SERVER_AUTH_CONFIG_FILEPATH
variables.description: Path to a TOML file containing authentication configuration for the HTTP Control Server

variables.name: Variable: HEALTH_TARGET_ADDRESSES
variables.description: Comma-separated addresses to ping on every internal health check (replaces HEALTH_TARGET_ADDRESS)

variables.name: Variable: HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_INITIAL
variables.description: Initial duration to wait for the VPN to be ready

variables.name: Variable: HEALTH_VPN_DURATION_ADDITION
variables.description: Additional duration to add for each consecutive VPN failure

variables.name: Variable: HEALTH_SUCCESS_WAIT_DURATION
variables.description: Duration to wait after a success check

variables.name: Variable: HEALTH_SERVER_ADDRESS
variables.description: Internal health check server listening address

variables.name: Variable: UPDATER_PERIOD
variables.description: Period to update VPN servers data e.g. '24h' (0 to disable)

variables.name: Variable: UPDATER_MIN_RATIO
variables.description: Ratio of servers to be found for update to succeed

variables.name: Variable: UPDATER_VPN_SERVICE_PROVIDERS
variables.description: List of providers to update servers data for

variables.name: Variable: STORAGE_FILEPATH
variables.description: Path of servers.json file (empty to disable caching)

variables.name: Variable: TZ
variables.description: Specify a timezone to use to have correct log times. i.e. Europe/London

variables.name: Variable: PUID
variables.description: User ID to run as non root

variables.name: Variable: PGID
variables.description: Group ID to run as non root

variables.name: Variable: PUBLICIP_ENABLED
variables.description: Check for public IP address information on VPN connection

variables.name: Variable: PUBLICIP_API
variables.description: Public IP echo service API to use

variables.name: Variable: PUBLICIP_API_TOKEN
variables.description: Optional API token for the public IP echo service

variables.name: Variable: PUBLICIP_FILE
variables.description: Filepath to store the public IP address assigned

variables.name: Variable: VERSION_INFORMATION
variables.description: Logs a message indicating if a newer version is available
